arStrings.szText: They saw us coming. Mad cultists in filthy rags flung themselves at our party, only to be crushed under the furious blows of the Druids. I looked one in the eyes as he died. Not a demon. Only a man.

Then out of the silence, we heard crying. Six children—frightened but safe inside the chapel. When Vasily wrapped his son in his arms, I turned to hide my tears. I had saved this boy, but it could not change the fact that I had failed my own.

I felt a great paw on my shoulder, then met the smiling eyes of a Druid. “You are Deckard Cain. Descendent of Jered Cain.” she said. “Our ancestors are grateful to you. They say to seek yours in the Mistral Woods.”
